definition_en: feeling pleased and content, or willing to do something
core_image: 一个孩子接到礼物时笑弯了眼睛
scene: 她收到礼物时很开心。She was happy when she got the gift.
sceneCN: 这里 happy 是「高兴的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她收到礼物时很开心。

senses.title: Glad about something
senses.definition: feeling pleasure about something that has happened
senses.definitionCN: 因发生某事而感到愉快
senses.example: She was happy when she got the gift.
senses.why: This is the everyday feeling sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最日常的情绪义项。

senses.title: Content in life
senses.definition: satisfied with life and not troubled
senses.definitionCN: 对生活满足而无忧
senses.example: They live a happy life in the country.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在乡下过着幸福的生活。
senses.why: The feeling lasts long enough to become a life.
senses.whyCN: 情绪持续得够久，就成了一种生活。

senses.title: Willing
senses.definition: willing and glad to do something
senses.definitionCN: 愿意并乐于去做某事
senses.example: I am happy to help.
senses.why: A pleased mind says yes more easily.
senses.whyCN: 愉快的心，更容易说行。

intro.en: Happy comes from the noun hap, luck or chance, plus the ending -y.
intro.cn: happy 由名词 hap（运气、机缘）加后缀 -y 构成。

items.en: Happ meant luck or chance.
items.cn: happ 意为运气或机缘。

items.en: Hap named good fortune.
items.cn: hap 指好运。

items.en: Happy meant favoured by luck.
items.cn: happy 意为受到幸运眷顾的。

items.en: The sense moved to inner pleasure.
items.cn: 词义转向内心的愉悦。

items.en: Happy also came to mean willing.
items.cn: happy 也引申为「乐意」。

note.en: Happy is compared with look-alike words and with words for good feeling.
note.cn: 把 happy 与形近词以及表示良好感受的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Happy began as good luck and became a warm feeling inside.
normalIntro.cn: happy 起初指好运气，后来变成心里的一股暖意。

normal.en: He is happy with the result.

abstract.en: Luck was once the whole of happiness.
abstract.cn: 曾经，运气就是全部的幸福。

abstract.en: A happy face is a door left open.
abstract.cn: 一张笑脸，是一扇开着的门。

abstract.en: To say yes gladly is its own small joy.
abstract.cn: 乐意说「好」，本身就是小小的快乐。

examples.en: She was happy when she got the gift.
They live a happy life in the country.
examples.cn: 他们在乡下过着幸福的生活。

examples.en: I am happy to help.

dict_mnemonic.text: happy 由 hap（运气）加 -y 构成，本指「走运」，后指内心的「高兴、幸福」；be happy to 是乐意做，happy ending 是圆满结局。

root: 来自古诺斯语 happ（运气、机缘），加形容词后缀 -y；由「受幸运眷顾」引申为内心的愉悦、生活的幸福与做事的乐意。

sensesIntro.en: Happy describes a glad moment, a contented life, or a willing yes.
sensesIntro.cn: happy 描述一时的高兴、一生的幸福，或乐意的一句应允。

core.en: A face that has just relaxed into a smile.
core.cn: 一张刚刚舒展成笑的脸。

branches.en: A parcel opens and eyes grow bright.
branches.cn: 包裹一开，眼睛就亮了。

branches.en: A family eats together every evening.
branches.cn: 一家人每天傍晚一起吃饭。

branches.en: A hand rises before the request ends.
branches.cn: 请求还没说完，手就举了起来。

branches.en: Small glad moments build a happy life.
branches.cn: 一个个小高兴，垒成幸福的一生。

branches.en: A glad heart says yes first.
branches.cn: 愉快的心，总是先说出「好」。

intro.en: Happy takes comparison and forms a noun, an adverb, and a negative form.
intro.cn: happy 加比较级，并构成名词、副词与否定形式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word comes from Old Norse.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，来自古诺斯语。

items.example: He was unhappy with the plan.

items.meaning: a good end to a story
items.example: The film has a happy ending.

items.exampleCN: 他们在优惠时段见了面。

definition_en: a sheltered place where ships can stay, or to shelter something
core_image: 一群小船躲在防波堤后的静水里
scene: 渔船驶回了港口。The fishing boats returned to the harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 harbour 是「港口」（第 1 个义项）；句意：渔船驶回了港口。

senses.title: Sheltered port
senses.definition: an area of water sheltered from the sea where ships can stay
senses.definitionCN: 避开外海风浪、可供船只停泊的水域
senses.example: The fishing boats returned to the harbour.
senses.why: This is the basic place sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的地点义项。

senses.title: Place of refuge
senses.definition: a place that gives safety from danger or trouble
senses.definitionCN: 使人免受危险或困扰的安全之处
senses.example: The library was a harbour from the noise.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆是躲避喧闹的港湾。
senses.why: A port protects ships, so the word protects people too.
senses.whyCN: 港口护住船只，于是也用来护住人。

senses.title: Shelter someone
senses.definition: to give shelter to a person or animal
senses.definitionCN: 给人或动物提供藏身之处
senses.example: They harboured the stray dog.
senses.exampleCN: 他们收留了那只流浪狗。
senses.why: The noun of shelter became a verb.
senses.whyCN: 庇护的名词，转成了动词。

senses.title: Keep a feeling
senses.definition: to keep a thought or feeling secretly in the mind
senses.definitionCN: 在心里暗暗保留某种想法或情感
senses.example: He harboured doubts for years.
senses.why: The mind can be a harbour for thoughts.
senses.whyCN: 头脑也可以成为想法的港湾。

intro.en: Harbour comes from Old English herebeorg, an army shelter, later any refuge.
intro.cn: harbour 来自古英语 herebeorg（军队的营地），后来泛指避难所。

items.en: The root meant a shelter for an army.
items.cn: 该词根指军队的庇护所。

items.en: Herebeorg meant a lodging or camp.
items.cn: herebeorg 指住处或营地。

items.en: Harbour named a place of safety.
items.cn: harbour 指安全之处。

items.en: It became the usual word for a port.
items.cn: 它成为「港口」的常用词。

items.en: The verb named sheltering and holding ideas.
items.cn: 动词义指收留与心怀想法。

note.en: Harbour is compared with look-alike words and with words for ports and shelter.
note.cn: 把 harbour 与形近词以及表示港口和庇护的词作比较。

entries.definition: a town or place where ships load

normalIntro.en: A harbour holds ships, then holds people, then holds thoughts.
normalIntro.cn: 港口先容下船，再容下人，最后容下念头。

normal.en: The ship entered the harbour at dusk.
This bay is a natural harbour.
The church became a harbour for the homeless.
normal.cn: 教堂成了无家可归者的避难所。

normal.en: She harbours a hope of returning.

abstract.en: Every ship needs a wall against the sea.
abstract.cn: 每条船，都需要一道挡海的墙。

abstract.en: A harbour says nothing and keeps everything.
abstract.cn: 港湾什么也不说，却容下一切。

abstract.en: The heart is the last harbour we build.
abstract.cn: 心，是我们建的最后一个港湾。

examples.en: The fishing boats returned to the harbour.
The library was a harbour from the noise.
examples.cn: 图书馆是躲避喧闹的港湾。

examples.en: He harboured doubts for years.

dict_mnemonic.text: harbour 是「港口」，也指「避难所」；作动词是「庇护、藏匿」，还可表示心里「怀有」想法或怨恨，harbour a grudge 是心怀怨恨。

root: 来自古英语 herebeorg（军队营地），源于日耳曼语；由庇护之所引申为港口与避难所，再引申为心里怀藏某种念头。

sensesIntro.en: Harbour is a sheltered port, a refuge, the act of sheltering, or a feeling kept inside.
sensesIntro.cn: harbour 是避风的港口、避难所、收留的动作，或藏在心里的情感。

core.en: Still water behind a breakwater.
core.cn: 防波堤后的静水。

branches.en: Boats line up behind a stone wall.
branches.cn: 小船排在石墙后。

branches.en: A tired walker finds a dry doorway.
branches.cn: 疲惫的行人找到一个干燥的门洞。

branches.en: A warm kitchen takes in a wet dog.
branches.cn: 温暖的厨房收留了一只湿透的狗。

branches.en: An old man keeps one quiet hope.
branches.cn: 老人守着一个安静的希望。

branches.en: A place and a mind can both give shelter.
branches.cn: 一个地方与一颗心，都能提供庇护。

intro.en: Harbour takes plural and verb endings and forms trade compounds.
intro.cn: harbour 加复数与动词词尾，并构成行业复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.meaning: an official in charge of a port
items.exampleCN: 港务长招手让我们进港。

items.example: The cove is a safe harbour.

definition_zh: 硬的；困难的；努力的；猛烈地
definition_en: firm and solid, difficult to do, or using a lot of effort
core_image: 拳头敲在硬木桌面上发出闷响
scene: 这张床太硬，睡不舒服。The bed is too hard to sleep on.
sceneCN: 这里 hard 是「硬的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这张床太硬，睡不舒服。

senses.title: Firm to the touch
senses.definition: firm and solid and not easily pressed or bent
senses.definitionCN: 坚实而不易按压或弯曲的
senses.example: The bed is too hard to sleep on.
senses.why: This is the physical material sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是材料层面的物理义项。

senses.title: Difficult
senses.definition: difficult to do or to understand
senses.definitionCN: 难以做到或理解的
senses.example: It is hard to say.
senses.why: A hard surface resists the hand, as a hard task resists effort.
senses.whyCN: 硬的表面抗拒手，难的任务抗拒努力。

senses.title: Full of effort
senses.definition: showing or needing a lot of effort and energy
senses.definitionCN: 付出或需要大量精力与努力的
senses.example: He is a hard worker.
senses.why: What resists you must be pushed hard.
senses.whyCN: 抗拒你的东西，必须用力去推。

senses.title: With force
senses.definition: with great effort or force, as an adverb
senses.definitionCN: 作副词时指用力或猛烈地
senses.example: It rained hard all night.
senses.why: The adverb keeps the idea of force.
senses.whyCN: 副词形式保留了「用力」的意思。

intro.en: Hard comes from Old English heard, firm or severe.
intro.cn: hard 来自古英语 heard，意为坚实或严厉。

items.en: The root meant firm and strong.
items.cn: 该词根意为坚实、强壮。

items.en: Heard described a hard surface.
items.cn: heard 描述坚硬的表面。

items.en: Hard extended to difficult tasks.
items.cn: hard 扩展到困难的任务。

items.en: It also praised steady effort.
items.cn: 它也用来称赞持续的努力。

items.en: The adverb sense grew alongside.
items.cn: 副词义也随之发展。

note.en: Hard is compared with look-alike words and with words for firmness and difficulty.
note.cn: 把 hard 与形近词以及表示坚硬和困难的词作比较。

entries.definition: able to live in hard conditions
an animal like a large rabbit

normalIntro.en: Hard is a wall under the hand, a task against the will, and the force you answer with.
normalIntro.cn: hard 是手下的一面墙，是挡在意志前的一件难事，也是你回敬它的那股力。

normal.en: The ground is hard and dry.

abstract.en: What is hard teaches the hand its strength.
abstract.cn: 坚硬的东西，教会手它的力量。

abstract.en: A hard road is still a road.
abstract.cn: 难走的路，仍然是路。

abstract.en: Effort is the answer a hard world asks for.
abstract.cn: 努力，是坚硬的世界索要的答案。

examples.en: The bed is too hard to sleep on.
It is hard to say.
It rained hard all night.

dict_mnemonic.text: hard 本义是「硬的」，引申为「困难的」「努力的」；作副词是「努力地、猛烈地」，如 work hard、rain hard；注意 hardly 意思完全不同，是「几乎不」。

root: 来自古英语 heard（坚实、严厉），源于日耳曼语；由坚固的表面，引申为难以对付的任务，再引申为用力与勤勉。

sensesIntro.en: Hard describes a solid surface, a difficult task, steady effort, or force in action.
sensesIntro.cn: hard 描述坚实的表面、困难的任务、持续的努力，或动作中的力量。

core.en: A surface that resists the hand.
core.cn: 抗拒手掌的表面。

branches.en: Knuckles knock on a wooden table.
branches.cn: 指节敲在木桌上。

branches.en: A question has no ready answer.
branches.cn: 一个问题没有现成答案。

branches.en: A lamp stays on past midnight.
branches.cn: 一盏灯亮过午夜。

branches.en: Rain beats against a window.
branches.cn: 雨猛打在窗户上。

branches.en: A hard task is met with hard work.
branches.cn: 难的任务，用努力去接。

intro.en: Hard takes comparison and builds adverbs, verbs, and nouns of effort.
intro.cn: hard 加比较级，并构成副词、动词与表示艰难的名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The hardness of the wood helps.

definition_en: to become firm or solid, or to become less gentle and more severe
core_image: 湿润的泥巴在太阳下慢慢干裂发硬
scene: 冷风让泥土变硬了。The cold wind hardened the soil.
sceneCN: 这里 harden 是「使变硬」（第 1 个义项）；句意：冷风让泥土变硬了。

senses.title: Become solid
senses.definition: to become firm and solid
senses.definitionCN: 变得坚实而坚硬
senses.example: The cold wind hardened the soil.
senses.why: This is the material sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是材料层面的义项。

senses.title: Become strong
senses.definition: to make a person strong enough to face difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 使人坚强到足以面对困难
senses.example: The years had hardened him.
senses.why: Hard material became a hard character.
senses.whyCN: 坚硬的材料，变成了坚硬的性格。

senses.title: Become severe
senses.definition: to make an attitude or rule less gentle
senses.definitionCN: 使态度或规定变得不再宽和
senses.example: Their attitude hardened after the attack.
senses.exampleCN: 那次袭击之后，他们的态度变强硬了。
senses.why: Strength in the wrong place becomes severity.
senses.whyCN: 用错地方的坚强，就成了严厉。

intro.en: Harden is hard plus the verb ending -en, formed in Middle English.
intro.cn: harden 是 hard 加动词词尾 -en，在中古英语中构成。

items.en: Heard meant firm.
items.cn: heard 意为坚实。

items.en: Harden meant to make firm.
items.cn: harden 意为使变硬。

items.en: It described clay, metal, and cement.
items.cn: 它描述黏土、金属与水泥。

items.en: The sense moved to hardened people.
items.cn: 词义扩展到变得坚强的人。

items.en: It also named hardened attitudes.
items.cn: 它也指变得强硬的态度。

note.en: Harden is compared with look-alike words and with words for becoming firm.
note.cn: 把 harden 与形近词以及表示变坚硬的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Harden turns soft clay into stone, and a soft heart into something that can bear the cold.
normalIntro.cn: harden 把软泥变成石头，也把柔软的心变成能抗住寒冷的东西。

normal.en: The cement hardened in a day.
He hardened his heart against pity.

normal.cn: 随着时间推移，他们的看法变得强硬。

abstract.en: What one hardens can no longer bend.
abstract.cn: 被弄硬的东西，就再也弯不了了。

abstract.en: A hardened heart is a wall with no door.
abstract.cn: 变硬的心，是一堵没有门的墙。

abstract.en: Strength is a good servant and a bad master.
abstract.cn: 坚强是好仆人，却是坏主人。

examples.en: The cold wind hardened the soil.
The years had hardened him.
Their attitude hardened after the attack.
examples.cn: 那次袭击之后，他们的态度变强硬了。

dict_mnemonic.text: harden 是 hard 加 -en，指「使变硬、变硬」，如水泥凝固；也可指人「变得坚强」或态度「变得强硬」，harden the heart 是铁了心。

root: hard（硬的）加动词后缀 -en；由物质变硬，引申为人变得坚强，以及态度、规定变得严厉强硬。

sensesIntro.en: Harden means to turn soft material solid, a soft person strong, or a mild attitude severe.
sensesIntro.cn: harden 指让软材料变硬、让柔软的人变强，或让温和的态度变严厉。

core.en: Wet clay drying into a hard shape.
core.cn: 湿黏土干成坚硬的形状。

branches.en: Frost turns mud into stone.
branches.cn: 霜把泥变成石头。

branches.en: A worker carries more each year.
branches.cn: 一个工人每年承担得更多。

branches.en: A rule becomes stricter after one mistake.
branches.cn: 一次失误后，规定变得严格。

branches.en: The ground and the spirit both test the frost.
branches.cn: 土地与精神，都要经受霜冻的检验。

branches.en: A strength that closes becomes a hardness.
branches.cn: 封闭起来的坚强，就成了冷酷。

intro.en: Harden follows the -en pattern of verbs from adjectives.
intro.cn: harden 遵循「形容词加 -en 变动词」的模式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

definition_en: almost not at all, or only just
core_image: 一束几乎看不见的微光
scene: 他几乎听不见她的声音。He could hardly hear her voice.
sceneCN: 这里 hardly 是「几乎不」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他几乎听不见她的声音。

senses.title: Almost not
senses.definition: to almost no degree at all
senses.definitionCN: 程度几乎为零
senses.example: He could hardly hear her voice.
senses.exampleCN: 他几乎听不见她的声音。
senses.why: This is the main modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代最主要的意思。

senses.title: Surely not
senses.definition: used to say that something is very unlikely or unsuitable
senses.definitionCN: 用于表示某事极不可能或不合适
senses.example: That is hardly a fair answer.
senses.exampleCN: 那简直算不上公平的回答。
senses.why: The same smallness turns into doubt.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「极少」，转成了怀疑。

senses.title: Only just
senses.definition: only a moment ago
senses.definitionCN: 只在片刻之前
senses.example: I had hardly arrived when it rained.
senses.why: An older sense of barely in time.
senses.whyCN: 这是「时间上刚好」的古老义项。

intro.en: Hardly is hard plus -ly, which first meant with force and later almost not.
intro.cn: hardly 是 hard 加 -ly，最初意为「用力地」，后转为「几乎不」。

items.en: Heard meant firm.
items.cn: heard 意为坚实。

items.en: Hardly meant with force.
items.cn: hardly 意为用力地。

items.en: The sense shifted to barely.
items.cn: 词义转向「勉强、几乎不」。

items.en: Hardly ever became a common phrase.
items.cn: hardly ever 成为常用搭配。

items.en: Hardly also marked things almost untrue.
items.cn: hardly 也用来表示「简直不」。

note.en: Hardly is compared with look-alike words and with words of small degree.
note.cn: 把 hardly 与形近词以及表示微小程度的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Hardly looks like hard but means almost not, a small light on the edge of seeing.
normalIntro.cn: hardly 看着像 hard，意思却是「几乎不」，像视野边缘的一点微光。

normal.en: There is hardly any water left.
I had hardly sat down when the phone rang.

abstract.en: What is hardly there still asks to be noticed.
abstract.cn: 几乎不存在的东西，仍然渴望被看见。

abstract.en: Hard work and hardly working are a letter apart.
abstract.cn: 努力工作与几乎不做，只差一个字母。

abstract.en: Almost nothing is still something.
abstract.cn: 几乎什么都没有，也还是有一点。

examples.en: He could hardly hear her voice.
examples.cn: 他几乎听不见她的声音。

examples.en: That is hardly a fair answer.
examples.cn: 那简直算不上公平的回答。

examples.en: I had hardly arrived when it rained.

dict_mnemonic.text: hardly 虽是 hard 加 -ly，意思却不是「努力地」，而是「几乎不」；hardly ever 是几乎从不，hardly any 是几乎没有，hardly...when 是刚一……就。

root: hard（用力、艰难）加 -ly；中古英语本指「用力地」，后词义转为「勉强、几乎不」与「简直不」。

sensesIntro.en: Hardly means almost not, surely not, or only just.
sensesIntro.cn: hardly 指几乎不、简直不，或刚刚才。

core.en: A light too faint to be sure of.
core.cn: 弱得让人不敢确定的一点光。

branches.en: A voice fades at the far end of a hall.

branches.cn: 门刚关上，敲门声就响了。

branches.cn: 「刚刚」不过是极少的一点时间。

definition_en: a situation in which life is very difficult because of a lack of money or comfort
core_image: 一间漏风的屋子里只点着一支蜡烛
scene: 战争年代他们经历了许多困苦。They faced great hardship during the war.
sceneCN: 这里 hardship 是「困苦」（第 1 个义项）；句意：战争年代他们经历了许多困苦。

senses.title: Difficult living conditions
senses.definition: conditions of life that are hard because of poverty or lack of comfort
senses.definitionCN: 因贫穷或缺乏舒适而艰难的生活条件
senses.example: They faced great hardship during the war.
senses.exampleCN: 战争年代他们经历了许多困苦。
senses.why: This is the main social sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最主要的社会义项。

senses.title: A hard experience
senses.definition: something difficult that a person has to go through
senses.definitionCN: 一个人不得不经历的难事
senses.example: Moving alone was a real hardship.
senses.exampleCN: 独自搬家真是件艰难的事。
senses.why: The state of difficulty is also counted one by one.
senses.whyCN: 艰难的状态，也能一件件数出来。

senses.title: Suffering
senses.definition: serious suffering caused by hard conditions
senses.definitionCN: 由艰苦条件造成的严重痛苦
senses.example: The book describes the hardships of the poor.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书描写了穷人的苦难。
senses.why: The plural names many separate troubles.
senses.whyCN: 复数形式指许多各自分开的苦处。

intro.en: Hardship is hard plus the noun ending -ship, which names a state or condition.

items.en: Heard meant firm or severe.

items.en: The ending -ship named a condition.
items.cn: 后缀 -ship 表示一种处境。

items.en: Hardship named a state of severe difficulty.
items.cn: hardship 指极为艰难的处境。

items.en: The word spread to money troubles.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到经济上的困难。

items.en: The plural named many separate troubles.
items.cn: 复数形式指许多具体的苦处。

note.en: Hardship is compared with look-alike words and with words for difficulty and suffering.
note.cn: 把 hardship 与形近词以及表示困难和痛苦的词作比较。

entries.definition: the state of being hard to do
great pain of body or mind
the state of being very poor

normalIntro.en: Hardship is hard turned into a condition of life, and then counted one by one.
normalIntro.cn: hardship 是「hard」变成的一种生活处境，然后被一件件数出来。

normal.cn: 经济困难让工厂关了门。

normal.en: She never spoke of her hardships.
The scholarship helps students in hardship.
normal.cn: 这项奖学金帮助有困难的学生。

abstract.en: Hardship is a teacher no one invites.
abstract.cn: 困苦是没人邀请的老师。

abstract.en: A life without friction never learns its own shape.
abstract.cn: 没有摩擦的生活，永远不知道自己是什么形状。

abstract.en: What is endured quietly becomes strength later.
abstract.cn: 默默忍受的东西，日后会变成力量。

examples.en: They faced great hardship during the war.
examples.cn: 战争年代他们经历了许多困苦。

examples.en: Moving alone was a real hardship.
examples.cn: 独自搬家真是件艰难的事。

examples.en: The book describes the hardships of the poor.
examples.cn: 这本书描写了穷人的苦难。

dict_mnemonic.text: hardship 是 hard 加后缀 -ship（状态），指生活上的「困苦、艰难」；economic hardship 是经济困难，face hardship 是面对困苦，复数 hardships 指一桩桩具体的苦处。

root: hard（艰难的）加名词后缀 -ship（处境、状态）；指因贫穷或匮乏而艰难的生活状态，复数指具体的苦难。

sensesIntro.en: Hardship is hard living, a single hard experience, or many separate sufferings.
sensesIntro.cn: hardship 是艰难的生活、一次艰难的遭遇，或一桩桩苦难。

core.en: A room with a cold draft.
core.cn: 一间灌着冷风的屋子。

branches.en: A family eats thin soup for weeks.
branches.cn: 一家人连着几周喝稀汤。

branches.en: A young man carries his bags up six floors.
branches.cn: 一个年轻人提着行李爬六层楼。

branches.en: An old woman counts the winters she survived.
branches.cn: 老妇人数着她熬过的冬天。

branches.en: A hard condition becomes a hard memory.
branches.cn: 艰难的处境，变成艰难的记忆。

branches.en: Each single trouble becomes part of the whole suffering.
branches.cn: 一桩桩难处，汇成整体的苦难。

intro.en: Hardship is a mass noun with a countable plural for separate troubles.
intro.cn: hardship 是不可数名词，复数则指一桩桩具体的苦难。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.

items.exampleCN: 困苦让他们变得有耐心。

items.example: He tested the hardness of the stone.
The fund helps families in financial hardship.
items.exampleCN: 该基金帮助有经济困难的家庭。

definition_en: the physical parts of a computer, or tools and metal goods for the home
core_image: 货架上摆满锤子、钉子和一把把螺丝刀
scene: 电脑硬件需要定期升级。The computer hardware needs an upgrade.
sceneCN: 这里 hardware 是「硬件」（第 1 个义项）；句意：电脑硬件需要定期升级。

senses.title: Computer machinery
senses.definition: the physical parts of a computer rather than its programs
senses.definitionCN: 计算机的实体部件，而非其程序
senses.example: The computer hardware needs an upgrade.
senses.why: This is the modern technical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代技术义项。

senses.title: Metal goods for the home
senses.definition: tools and metal items sold for building and repair
senses.definitionCN: 建筑与修理用的工具和金属制品
senses.example: He bought nails at the hardware store.
senses.why: This is the original shop sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最早的五金店义项。

senses.title: Heavy equipment
senses.definition: large machines or weapons used by an army
senses.definitionCN: 军队使用的大型机械或武器
senses.example: The army moved its hardware north.
senses.why: Things made of hard metal became tools of force.
senses.whyCN: 硬金属制品，成了武力的工具。

intro.en: Hardware is hard plus ware, goods, first naming metal goods and later computer parts.
intro.cn: hardware 是 hard 加 ware（货物），先指金属制品，后指计算机部件。

items.en: Waru meant goods or articles.
items.cn: waru 意为货物、物品。

items.en: Hardware named goods made of hard metal.
items.cn: hardware 指硬金属制成的货物。

items.en: A hardware store sold tools and nails.
items.cn: 五金店卖工具与钉子。

items.en: The word named military equipment.
items.cn: 这个词指军事装备。

items.en: Computers gave it a new sense.
items.cn: 计算机赋予了它新义。

note.en: Hardware is compared with look-alike words and with words for equipment.
note.cn: 把 hardware 与形近词以及表示设备的词作比较。

entries.definition: the things needed for an activity
a thing used to do work

normalIntro.en: Hardware began as hammers and nails and now also means the metal inside a computer.
normalIntro.cn: hardware 起初是锤子和钉子，如今也指电脑里的金属部件。

normal.en: The hardware store is on the corner.
He fixed the shelf with new hardware.
normal.cn: 他用新五金件修好了架子。
这台笔记本电脑硬件很强。

normal.en: Hardware and software must work together.
normal.cn: 硬件与软件必须协同工作。

abstract.en: What is hard in the hand is easy to name.
abstract.cn: 手里坚硬的东西，最容易命名。

abstract.en: A body of metal still needs a mind of code.
abstract.cn: 金属的身躯，仍需代码的心。

abstract.en: Tools change, but the hand that holds them is old.
abstract.cn: 工具会变，握工具的手却很古老。

examples.en: The computer hardware needs an upgrade.
He bought nails at the hardware store.
The army moved its hardware north.

dict_mnemonic.text: hardware 是 hard 加 ware（制品），原指金属五金，所以五金店叫 hardware store；计算机时代又指看得见摸得着的「硬件」，与 software 相对。

root: hard（硬的）加 ware（制品、货物）；原指硬金属制成的五金器具，后扩展为军事装备与计算机硬件。

sensesIntro.en: Hardware is the metal inside a computer, the tools sold in a shop, or heavy military equipment.
sensesIntro.cn: hardware 是电脑中的实体部件、商店里卖的五金工具，或军队的重型装备。

core.en: Something hard that can be held.
core.cn: 能握在手里的硬东西。

branches.en: A case opens to show boards and chips.
branches.cn: 机箱打开，露出主板与芯片。

branches.en: Drawers hold screws and hinges.
branches.cn: 抽屉里装着螺丝与铰链。

branches.en: Trucks carry steel to a distant camp.
branches.cn: 卡车把钢铁运往远方营地。

branches.en: Both a computer and an army rely on solid metal.
branches.cn: 电脑与军队，都依赖坚实的金属。

branches.en: The shop and the machine share one material.
branches.cn: 店铺与机器，共用同一种材料。

intro.en: Hardware is a compound of hard and ware and has no plural.
intro.cn: hardware 是 hard 与 ware 的复合词，没有复数形式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The hardware upgrade doubled the speed.

definition_en: damage or injury to a person or thing, or to cause such damage
core_image: 一只脚踩坏了刚刚长出的嫩芽
scene: 吸烟会伤害身体。Smoking can harm your health.
sceneCN: 这里 harm 是「伤害」（第 3 个义项，动词）；句意：吸烟会伤害身体。

senses.title: Injury to the body
senses.definition: physical injury or damage to a person or animal
senses.definitionCN: 对人畜造成的身体损伤
senses.example: The fall did him no harm.
senses.why: This is the basic injury sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的损伤义项。

senses.title: Damage to interests
senses.definition: damage to something valuable, such as trust or reputation
senses.definitionCN: 对信任、名誉等有价值之物的破坏
senses.example: The rumour harmed her reputation.
senses.exampleCN: 那则谣言损害了她的名誉。
senses.why: What can hurt a body can hurt a name.
senses.whyCN: 能伤身体的，也能伤名声。

senses.title: Cause damage
senses.definition: to cause damage or injury to someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 对某人或某物造成损伤或破坏
senses.example: Smoking can harm your health.
senses.why: The noun of damage became a verb.
senses.whyCN: 损害的名词，转成了动词。

intro.en: Harm comes from Old English hearm, injury or grief.
intro.cn: harm 来自古英语 hearm，意为伤害或悲痛。

items.en: The root meant injury.
items.cn: 该词根意为损伤。

items.en: Hearm meant harm or sorrow.
items.cn: hearm 意为伤害或悲伤。

items.en: Harm named damage of any kind.
items.cn: harm 指任何形式的损害。

items.en: The verb sense of injuring grew.
items.cn: 「使受伤」的动词义发展起来。

items.en: The phrase no harm done became common.
items.cn: no harm done 成为常用说法。

note.en: Harm is compared with look-alike words and with words for damage and injury.
note.cn: 把 harm 与形近词以及表示损害和伤害的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Harm is a foot on a young shoot, a word on a good name, and an action against a body.
normalIntro.cn: harm 是踩在新芽上的一只脚，是落在好名声上的一句话，也是加在身体上的一个动作。

normal.en: Too much sugar can harm your teeth.
No harm done, so let us go on.
normal.cn: 没造成伤害，我们继续吧。

normal.en: The law protects animals from harm.
normal.cn: 法律保护动物免受伤害。

abstract.en: What is done in a moment can harm for years.
abstract.cn: 一瞬间做的事，能伤害很多年。

abstract.en: The softest words can leave the deepest marks.
abstract.cn: 最软的话，能留下最深的痕。

abstract.en: To mean no harm is not the same as doing none.
abstract.cn: 没有恶意，不等于没有伤害。

examples.en: Smoking can harm your health.
The rumour harmed her reputation.
examples.cn: 那则谣言损害了她的名誉。

examples.en: The fall did him no harm.

dict_mnemonic.text: harm 可作名词也可作动词，都是「伤害、损害」；do harm to 是对……有害，no harm done 是没造成伤害，harm the environment 是损害环境。

root: 来自古英语 hearm（伤害、悲伤），源于日耳曼语；由身体的损伤，引申为名誉、利益与环境所受的破坏。

sensesIntro.en: Harm is injury to a body, damage to something valued, or the act of causing either.
sensesIntro.cn: harm 是对身体的损伤、对有价值之物的破坏，或造成这两者的行为。

core.en: A blow that leaves a mark.
core.cn: 留下痕迹的一击。

branches.en: A knee hits stone and swells.
branches.cn: 膝盖撞上石头，肿了起来。

branches.en: A false story spreads through a town.
branches.cn: 一个假消息在小镇传开。

branches.en: Smoke enters a pair of lungs.
branches.cn: 烟雾进入双肺。

branches.en: An injury and an injuring act are one event.
branches.cn: 伤与致伤的动作，是同一件事。

branches.en: A body and a reputation bruise the same way.
branches.cn: 身体与名誉，受伤的方式一样。

intro.en: Harm takes verb endings and forms two contrasting adjectives with -ful and -less.
intro.cn: harm 加动词词尾，并用 -ful 与 -less 构成两个相对形容词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The waste was disposed of harmfully.
items.exampleCN: 这些废物被有害地处理了。

definition_en: causing harm or damage
core_image: 一缕黑烟正飘向窗内的绿植
scene: 过强的阳光对皮肤有害。Too much sun is harmful to the skin.
sceneCN: 这里 harmful 是「有害的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：过强的阳光对皮肤有害。

senses.title: Bad for the body
senses.definition: likely to damage a person's health
senses.definitionCN: 很可能损害人的健康
senses.example: Too much sun is harmful to the skin.
senses.exampleCN: 过强的阳光对皮肤有害。
senses.why: This is the health sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是健康层面的义项。

senses.title: Bad for nature
senses.definition: likely to damage the natural world
senses.definitionCN: 很可能破坏自然环境
senses.example: These gases are harmful to the environment.
senses.why: The same damage aimed at a larger body.
senses.whyCN: 同样的损害，指向更大的身体。

senses.title: Bad for a person's good
senses.definition: likely to damage a person's development or judgement
senses.definitionCN: 很可能损害人的成长或判断
senses.example: Such advice can be harmful to a child.
senses.exampleCN: 这样的建议可能对孩子有害。
senses.why: The effect sense reaches beyond the body.
senses.whyCN: 影响层面的义项超出身体之外。

intro.en: Harmful is harm plus the adjective ending -ful, meaning full of.
intro.cn: harmful 是 harm 加形容词后缀 -ful，意为「充满……的」。

items.en: Hearm meant injury.
items.cn: hearm 意为伤害。

items.en: The ending -ful meant full of.
items.cn: 后缀 -ful 意为充满。

items.en: Harmful named what brings injury.
items.cn: harmful 指带来伤害的东西。

items.en: It spread to chemicals and habits.
items.cn: 它扩展到化学物质与习惯。

items.en: It also described effects on nature.
items.cn: 它也描述对自然的影响。

note.en: Harmful is compared with look-alike words and with words for causing damage.
note.cn: 把 harmful 与形近词以及表示造成损害的形容词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Harmful is a thing full of harm, whether it touches skin, air, or a young mind.
normalIntro.cn: harmful 就是装满伤害的东西，不论它碰到的是皮肤、空气，还是年幼的心。

normal.en: Plastic waste is harmful to fish.
Some insects are harmful to crops.

normal.cn: 这种药有有害的副作用。

abstract.en: What helps one thing may be harmful to another.
abstract.cn: 对一物有益的，可能对另一物有害。

abstract.en: The most harmful things often arrive quietly.
abstract.cn: 最有害的东西，往往悄悄地来。

abstract.en: To know what harms is the first form of care.
abstract.cn: 知道什么有害，是关心的第一步。

examples.en: Too much sun is harmful to the skin.
examples.cn: 过强的阳光对皮肤有害。

examples.en: These gases are harmful to the environment.
Such advice can be harmful to a child.
examples.cn: 这样的建议可能对孩子有害。

dict_mnemonic.text: harmful 是 harm 加 -ful，意为「有害的」，常用结构 be harmful to；说吸烟有害健康用 harmful to health，说塑料有害环境用 harmful to the environment。

root: harm（伤害）加形容词后缀 -ful（充满……的）；指容易造成身体、环境或成长方面损害的。

sensesIntro.en: Harmful means likely to damage health, the environment, or a person's good.
sensesIntro.cn: harmful 指容易损害健康、环境，或一个人的成长。

core.en: A thing that carries harm inside it.
core.cn: 一个自身携带着伤害的东西。

branches.en: Smoke reaches a pair of lungs.
branches.cn: 烟进入双肺。

branches.en: Waste water flows into a river.
branches.cn: 废水流入河流。

branches.en: A cruel word shapes a small mind.
branches.cn: 一句刻薄的话塑造了一颗小心灵。

branches.en: The same substance can hurt a body and a river.
branches.cn: 同一种物质，能伤害身体与河流。

branches.en: What pollutes the world also pollutes the young.
branches.cn: 污染世界的东西，也污染孩子。

intro.en: Harmful takes more and most and builds a noun and an adverb.
intro.cn: harmful 用 more 与 most 构成比较，并派生名词与副词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: They tested the harmfulness of the gas.
items.exampleCN: 他们检测了这种气体的有害性。

items.example: The dust is harmful to health.

definition_zh: 无害的；无恶意的；未受损伤的
definition_en: not able or likely to cause harm
core_image: 一条小蛇安静地盘在草丛里
scene: 这种蛇是无害的。This snake is harmless.
sceneCN: 这里 harmless 是「无害的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这种蛇是无害的。

senses.title: Not dangerous
senses.definition: not able to hurt a person or animal
senses.definitionCN: 不能伤害人或动物的
senses.example: This snake is harmless.
senses.why: This is the physical safety sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体安全层面的义项。

senses.title: Without bad intent
senses.definition: not meant to hurt or offend anyone
senses.definitionCN: 并非有意伤害或冒犯他人
senses.example: It was harmless fun.
senses.exampleCN: 那只是无伤大雅的玩笑。
senses.why: No harm in the body means no harm in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 身体无伤，心里也就没有恶意。

senses.title: Not damaged
senses.definition: not harmed or damaged after some event
senses.definitionCN: 经历某事之后未受伤损的

senses.exampleCN: 洪水过后，老教堂安然无恙。

senses.whyCN: 这是描述「逃过一劫」之物的少见义项。

intro.en: Harmless is harm plus the ending -less, meaning without.
intro.cn: harmless 是 harm 加后缀 -less，意为「没有……的」。

items.en: Hearm meant injury.
items.cn: hearm 意为伤害。

items.en: The ending -less meant without.
items.cn: 后缀 -less 意为没有。

items.en: Harmless described safe animals.
items.cn: harmless 描述安全的动物。

items.en: It also described innocent jokes.
items.cn: 它也描述无恶意的玩笑。

items.en: The word named what escaped damage.
items.cn: 这个词也指未受损的事物。

note.en: Harmless is compared with look-alike words and with words for safety and innocence.
note.cn: 把 harmless 与形近词以及表示安全和善意的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Harmless is a thing with no harm in it, and a word with no knife in it.
normalIntro.cn: harmless 是没有伤害的东西，也是没有藏刀的一句话。

normal.en: The medicine is harmless to children.

abstract.en: The harmless thing asks for no attention.
abstract.cn: 无害的东西，从不索要注意力。

abstract.en: Do not mistake quiet for harmless.
abstract.cn: 别把安静误认成无害。

abstract.en: The safest word is the one never meant to cut.
abstract.cn: 最安全的话，是从未打算割人的那句。

examples.en: This snake is harmless.
It was harmless fun.
examples.cn: 那只是无伤大雅的玩笑。

examples.en: The old church stood harmless after the flood.
examples.cn: 洪水过后，老教堂安然无恙。

dict_mnemonic.text: harmless 是 harm 加 -less（没有），意为「无害的」；也可说某句话或玩笑「无恶意」；与 harmful 正好相反，注意 -less 与 -ful 是一对。

root: harm（伤害）加形容词后缀 -less（没有……的）；指不能造成伤害、没有恶意，或未受损伤的。

sensesIntro.en: Harmless means unable to hurt, free of bad intent, or left undamaged.
sensesIntro.cn: harmless 指不能伤人、没有恶意，或未受损伤。

core.en: A creature that will not bite.
core.cn: 一个不会咬人的生物。

branches.en: A small snake slides past a foot.
branches.cn: 一条小蛇从脚边滑过。

branches.en: A joke ends in laughter on both sides.
branches.cn: 一个玩笑以双方大笑收场。

branches.en: A stone house stands after the water leaves.
branches.cn: 水退之后，石屋仍立着。

branches.en: No bite and no sting make a safe companion.
branches.cn: 不咬也不蜇，才是安全的同伴。

branches.en: To pass unhurt is to be untouched by harm.
branches.cn: 安然通过，就是没被伤害碰到。

intro.en: Harmless takes more and most and builds an adverb and a noun.
intro.cn: harmless 用 more 与 most 比较，并派生副词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: There is no harm in asking.
They proved the harmlessness of the drug.
items.exampleCN: 他们证明了这种药无害。
那只是无伤大雅的玩笑。

items.example: The insect is harmless to humans.

definition_en: a pleasing combination of sounds, or a peaceful and balanced relationship
core_image: 几把不同的乐器同时奏出同一个和弦
scene: 几个声部合在一起很和谐。The voices blended in harmony.
sceneCN: 这里 harmony 是「和谐」（第 1 个义项）；句意：几个声部合在一起很和谐。

senses.title: Pleasing sound
senses.definition: a combination of musical notes that sounds pleasant together
senses.definitionCN: 同时发声而听起来悦耳的音符组合
senses.example: The voices blended in harmony.
senses.exampleCN: 几个声部合在一起很和谐。
senses.why: This is the musical origin sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是源自音乐的义项。

senses.title: Things fitting together
senses.definition: a state in which different parts fit well together
senses.definitionCN: 不同部分彼此契合的状态
senses.example: The colours are in harmony.
senses.why: Pleasing notes became pleasing parts.
senses.whyCN: 悦耳的音，变成了悦目的搭配。

senses.title: Peace between people
senses.definition: a peaceful relationship without fighting
senses.definitionCN: 没有争斗的和平关系
senses.example: The two families live in harmony.
senses.why: Parts that fit in sound also fit in society.
senses.whyCN: 声音里契合的部分，也能在社会里契合。

intro.en: Harmony comes from Greek harmonia, a joining together.
intro.cn: harmony 来自希腊语 harmonia，意为连接、结合。

items.en: Harmonia meant a fitting together.
items.cn: harmonia 意为契合连接。

items.en: Harmonia entered Latin as harmony of sound.
items.cn: harmonia 在拉丁语中指声音的和谐。

items.en: The word reached English through French.
items.cn: 这个词经由法语进入英语。

items.en: Harmony named music and then agreement.
items.cn: harmony 先指音乐，后指一致。

items.en: It came to mean peace among people.
items.cn: 它进而指人与人之间的和睦。

note.en: Harmony is compared with look-alike words and with words for agreement and peace.
note.cn: 把 harmony 与形近词以及表示一致和和平的词作比较。

entries.definition: the state of having the same view

normalIntro.en: Harmony began as notes that fit and became people who fit.
normalIntro.cn: harmony 起初是彼此相合的音，后来成了彼此相合的人。

normal.en: The garden is in harmony with the house.
They lived in harmony for years.

normal.cn: 我们必须协调一致地工作。

normal.en: Peace and harmony returned to the town.
normal.cn: 和平与和睦回到了小镇。

abstract.en: Harmony is difference that has agreed to cooperate.
abstract.cn: 和谐，是差异同意合作。

abstract.en: One voice alone has no harmony to offer.
abstract.cn: 单独一个声音，给不出和声。

abstract.en: The sweetest sound is many sounds that do not fight.
abstract.cn: 最甜的声音，是许多不打架的声音。

examples.en: The voices blended in harmony.
examples.cn: 几个声部合在一起很和谐。

examples.en: The colours are in harmony.
The two families live in harmony.

dict_mnemonic.text: harmony 来自希腊语「连接」，先指声音的「和声、和谐」，再指颜色的「协调」与人际的「和睦」；in harmony with 是与……和谐一致。

root: 希腊语 harmonia（契合、连接）经拉丁语与法语进入英语；由和声的悦耳，引申为部分之间的协调与人际的和睦。

sensesIntro.en: Harmony is notes that sound well, parts that fit well, or people who live well together.
sensesIntro.cn: harmony 是悦耳的音、契合的部分，或和睦相处的人。

core.en: Two notes that meet and do not clash.
core.cn: 两个相遇而不冲突的音。

branches.en: A choir holds one long chord.
branches.cn: 合唱团保持一个长和弦。

branches.en: Curtains and walls share one colour.
branches.cn: 窗帘与墙共享一种颜色。

branches.en: Two neighbours share a fence and a meal.
branches.cn: 两家邻居共用一道篱笆和一餐饭。

branches.en: Sound and sight can both be tuned.
branches.cn: 声音与视觉，都能被调准。

branches.en: Things that fit make people who fit.
branches.cn: 彼此契合的东西，造就彼此契合的人。

intro.en: Harmony builds adjectives with -ious and a verb with -ize.
intro.cn: harmony 加 -ious 构成形容词，加 -ize 构成动词。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base harmonia means a joining.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词基 harmonia 意为连接。

items.example: The room is full of harmony.

items.exampleCN: 他们把两个方案协调起来。

definition_en: the straps and bands used to control a horse, or to control and use a force
core_image: 皮带与铜扣把一匹马稳稳系在车辕上
scene: 农民给马套上马具。The farmer put the harness on the horse.
sceneCN: 这里 harness 是「马具」（第 1 个义项）；句意：农民给马套上马具。

senses.title: Straps for an animal
senses.definition: the set of straps used to tie an animal to a cart or plough
senses.definitionCN: 把牲畜系在车或犁上的一套皮带
senses.example: The farmer put the harness on the horse.
senses.why: This is the basic object sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的实物义项。

senses.title: Put a force to work
senses.definition: to control and use a natural force for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为某种目的控制和利用自然力
senses.example: The dam harnesses the river.
senses.exampleCN: 大坝利用着这条河的力量。
senses.why: Straps that control a horse came to control power.
senses.whyCN: 控制马的皮带，变成了控制力量的手段。

senses.title: Strap an animal
senses.definition: to fasten a harness onto an animal
senses.definitionCN: 把马具系到牲畜身上
senses.example: They harnessed the horses at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在黎明时给马套上马具。
senses.why: The noun of straps became the act of strapping.
senses.whyCN: 皮带的名词，转成了系皮带这个动作。

intro.en: Harness comes from Old French harneis, equipment for a horse or soldier.
intro.cn: harness 来自古法语 harneis，指马匹或士兵的装备。

items.en: Harneis meant military equipment.
items.cn: harneis 意为军事装备。

items.en: Harness named the gear of a horse.
items.cn: harness 指马的挽具。

items.en: The verb named putting on the gear.
items.cn: 动词义指给牲口套上挽具。

items.en: Harness extended to water and wind.
items.cn: harness 扩展到水力与风力。

items.en: It now names using any great power.
items.cn: 现在它指利用任何巨大的力量。

note.en: Harness is compared with look-alike words and with words for using power.
note.cn: 把 harness 与形近词以及表示利用力量的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Harness is leather on a horse, then leather on a river of power.
normalIntro.cn: harness 先是套在马身上的皮带，后来套在力量之河上。

normal.en: The horse wore a leather harness.

normal.cn: 风电场利用空气的力量。

normal.en: We can harness sunlight for heat.
normal.cn: 我们可以利用阳光取暖。

normal.en: The climber wore a safety harness.
They harnessed the team to one goal.
normal.cn: 他们把团队的力量汇到一个目标上。

abstract.en: Power becomes useful only when it is held.
abstract.cn: 力量只有被握住，才有用处。

abstract.en: A wild river and a wild will both need a harness.
abstract.cn: 野河与野性，都需要一副挽具。

abstract.en: To harness is to listen to force before using it.
abstract.cn: 驾驭，是先听懂力量，再使用它。

examples.en: The farmer put the harness on the horse.
The dam harnesses the river.
examples.cn: 大坝利用着这条河的力量。

examples.en: They harnessed the horses at dawn.
examples.cn: 他们在黎明时给马套上马具。

dict_mnemonic.text: harness 本指马的「挽具」，把马系住才能干活，于是动词引申为「利用」自然力，如 harness solar energy 是利用太阳能；safety harness 是安全带。

root: 来自古法语 harneis（装备）；由给马套挽具，引申为控制并利用水力、风力、太阳能等巨大力量。

sensesIntro.en: Harness is gear for an animal, the use of a great force, or the act of strapping up.
sensesIntro.cn: harness 是牲畜的挽具、对巨大力量的利用，或套上挽具的动作。

core.en: Leather straps that hold a strong animal.
core.cn: 系住强壮牲畜的皮带。

branches.en: Buckled straps cross a horse's back.
branches.cn: 带扣的皮带横过马背。

branches.en: Water turns a wheel and lights a town.
branches.cn: 水推动轮子，点亮小镇。

branches.en: Hands buckle a collar before sunrise.
branches.cn: 日出前，双手扣上颈圈。

branches.en: The gear and the strapping are one action seen twice.
branches.cn: 挽具与套挽具，是同一动作的两种看法。

branches.en: To control a horse became to control a river.
branches.cn: 控制一匹马，变成了控制一条河。

intro.en: Harness takes plural and verb endings and forms gear compounds.
intro.cn: harness 加复数与动词词尾，并构成装备类复合词。

latinIntro.en: The word comes from Old French, not from Latin roots.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词来自古法语，并非拉丁词根。

items.example: The river is harnessed for power.
The team is back in harness.

items.exampleCN: 他们重新利用了老磨坊。

definition_zh: 严厉的；恶劣的；刺耳的；粗糙的
definition_en: unkind and severe, unpleasantly rough, or hard to live in
core_image: 砂纸般粗糙的表面划过指尖
scene: 冬天的风很刺骨。The winter wind was harsh.
sceneCN: 这里 harsh 是「恶劣的」（第 2 个义项）；句意：冬天的风很刺骨。

senses.title: Unkind and severe
senses.definition: cruel or unkind in words or treatment
senses.definitionCN: 言语或对待方式残酷、不仁慈
senses.example: He spoke in harsh words.
senses.why: This is the social sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是人际层面的义项。

senses.title: Hard to live in
senses.definition: severe and difficult, as weather or conditions
senses.definitionCN: 指天气或条件严酷艰难
senses.example: The winter wind was harsh.
senses.why: A severe manner and severe weather share one word.
senses.whyCN: 严厉的态度与严酷的天气，共用一个词。

senses.title: Unpleasant to sense
senses.definition: unpleasantly strong or rough to hear or see
senses.definitionCN: 听或看时令人不适的强烈粗糙
senses.example: The harsh light hurt my eyes.
senses.why: Roughness is felt by the ear and the eye.
senses.whyCN: 粗糙也能被耳朵和眼睛感到。

senses.title: Rough to touch
senses.definition: rough and unpleasant to touch
senses.definitionCN: 触感粗粝不适
senses.example: The cloth felt harsh on the skin.
senses.exampleCN: 这布料贴在皮肤上很粗。
senses.why: This is the original texture sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最初的质地义项。

intro.en: Harsh probably comes from a Germanic root meaning rough or hairy.
intro.cn: harsh 可能来自意为粗糙、多毛的日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root meant rough or hairy.
items.cn: 该词根意为粗糙或多毛。

items.en: Harsk described a rough surface.
items.cn: harsk 描述粗糙的表面。

items.en: Harsh described rough weather.
items.cn: harsh 描述恶劣的天气。

items.en: It also named severe words.
items.cn: 它也指严厉的言语。

items.en: It spread to light and sound.
items.cn: 它扩展到光线与声音。

note.en: Harsh is compared with look-alike words and with words for severity and roughness.
note.cn: 把 harsh 与形近词以及表示严厉和粗糙的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Harsh is a hand on sandpaper, a wind in a bare field, and a voice with no soft edge.
normalIntro.cn: harsh 是摸到砂纸的手，是刮过荒田的风，也是没有软边的声音。

normal.en: The judge gave a harsh punishment.

normal.cn: 他们生活在恶劣的条件下。

normal.en: The harsh light washed out the photo.
normal.cn: 刺眼的光让照片失去层次。

normal.en: The cloth is harsh to the touch.

abstract.en: What is rough teaches the skin its limits.
abstract.cn: 粗糙的东西，教会皮肤它的极限。

abstract.en: A harsh word outlives its speaker's mood.
abstract.cn: 一句刻薄话，会比说话人的情绪活得久。

abstract.en: Hard conditions do not excuse hard hearts.
abstract.cn: 艰难的处境，不能为冷酷开脱。

examples.en: The winter wind was harsh.
He spoke in harsh words.
The harsh light hurt my eyes.

dict_mnemonic.text: harsh 本指触感「粗糙」，引申为言语「严厉」、天气条件「恶劣」、光线声音「刺耳刺眼」；harsh words 是严厉的话，harsh conditions 是恶劣的条件。

root: 可能来自意为粗糙、多毛的日耳曼语词根；由触觉上的粗粝，引申为言语的严厉、环境的严酷与感官上的刺人。

sensesIntro.en: Harsh describes unkind words, severe conditions, senses that sting, or a surface that scratches.
sensesIntro.cn: harsh 描述刻薄的话、严酷的条件、刺人的感官刺激，或刮手的表面。

core.en: A surface that scrapes the skin.
core.cn: 刮着皮肤的表面。

branches.en: A judge speaks without softening a word.
branches.cn: 法官说话一句也不软。

branches.en: Wind crosses a field with no shelter.
branches.cn: 风刮过没有遮挡的田野。

branches.en: Noon light makes everyone squint.
branches.cn: 正午的光让所有人眯眼。

branches.en: A hand pulls back from rough cloth.
branches.cn: 手从粗布上缩回。

branches.en: A hard climate can make hard manners.
branches.cn: 严酷的气候，会造出严厉的举止。

intro.en: Harsh takes comparison and builds an adverb and a noun.
intro.cn: harsh 加比较级，并构成副词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The harshness of the sun surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 阳光的强烈让我们吃惊。
这个计划遭到严厉批评。

definition_en: great speed in doing something, often too much speed
core_image: 一个人边跑边系扣子，鞋还没穿好
scene: 他匆忙离开，忘了带伞。He left in haste and forgot his umbrella.
sceneCN: 这里 haste 是「匆忙」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他匆忙离开，忘了带伞。

senses.title: Great speed
senses.definition: quick movement or action, often because of hurry
senses.definitionCN: 因赶时间而快速的动作
senses.example: He left in haste and forgot his umbrella.
senses.why: This is the neutral speed sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是中性的速度义项。

senses.title: Too much speed
senses.definition: speed that is careless and causes mistakes
senses.definitionCN: 粗心并导致错误的过快
senses.example: The report was written in haste.
senses.why: Speed past a limit becomes a fault.
senses.whyCN: 快到超过限度，就成了过失。

senses.title: Rashness
senses.definition: a tendency to act too quickly without thought
senses.definitionCN: 不加思考就过快行动的倾向
senses.example: Haste led him to the wrong choice.
senses.exampleCN: 草率让他做出了错误的选择。
senses.why: The habit of hurrying became a character flaw.
senses.whyCN: 赶时间的习惯，成了一种性格缺点。

intro.en: Haste comes from Old French haste, speed or urgency.
intro.cn: haste 来自古法语 haste，意为迅速或紧急。

items.en: A Germanic root meant violence or speed.
items.cn: 一个日耳曼词根意为猛烈或迅速。

items.en: Haste meant urgency.
items.cn: haste 意为紧迫。

items.en: Haste named quick action.
items.cn: haste 指快速行动。

items.en: It also named careless speed.
items.cn: 它也指粗心的过快。

items.en: The proverb on waste became common.
items.cn: 关于欲速则不达的谚语广为流传。

note.en: Haste is compared with look-alike words and with words for speed and carelessness.
note.cn: 把 haste 与形近词以及表示快速和草率的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Haste is speed with no time to tie a shoe.
normalIntro.cn: haste 是快到连鞋带都来不及系的速度。

normal.en: Make haste or we will miss the train.
She wrote the note without haste.
normal.cn: 她不慌不忙地写下便条。

normal.en: The plan was made in haste.

abstract.en: Speed saves minutes and loses hours.
abstract.cn: 匆忙省下几分钟，却丢掉几个钟头。

abstract.en: What is done in haste is often done twice.
abstract.cn: 仓促做成的事，往往要做两遍。

abstract.en: The fastest step can be the longest mistake.
abstract.cn: 最快的一步，可能是最长的一个错误。

examples.en: He left in haste and forgot his umbrella.
The report was written in haste.
Haste led him to the wrong choice.
examples.cn: 草率让他做出了错误的选择。

dict_mnemonic.text: haste 是「匆忙」，in haste 是匆忙地，make haste 是赶快；匆忙过头就成了「仓促、草率」，谚语 Haste makes waste 就是欲速则不达。

root: 经由古法语 haste 来自日耳曼语，原含紧迫、猛烈之意；由迅速的行动，引申为因过快而造成的仓促与草率。

sensesIntro.en: Haste is fast action, careless speed, or the habit of acting too soon.
sensesIntro.cn: haste 是快速行动、粗心的过快，或过早行动的习性。

core.en: A person half-dressed and already at the door.
core.cn: 衣服没穿好就冲到门口的人。

branches.en: A door slams behind running feet.
branches.cn: 门在奔跑的脚步后关上。

branches.en: A page has three crossed-out errors.
branches.cn: 一页上有三处涂改的错误。

branches.en: A hand signs before reading the page.
branches.cn: 还没读完，手就签了字。

branches.en: Speed at the start becomes a mistake at the end.
branches.cn: 开头的快，成了结尾的错。

branches.en: One hurried choice teaches the next one caution.
branches.cn: 一次仓促的选择，教会下一次谨慎。

intro.en: Haste is a mass noun that builds an adjective, an adverb, and a verb.
intro.cn: haste 是不可数名词，可派生形容词、副词与动词。

latinIntro.en: The word comes through Old French, with a Germanic root behind it.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词经古法语传入，背后是日耳曼语词根。

items.example: Make haste, the bus is here.

definition_en: a covering worn on the head, or a role a person takes on
core_image: 一顶宽檐草帽挂在门边的钩子上
scene: 她戴着一顶草帽。She wore a straw hat.

intro.en: Hat comes from Old English hæt, a head covering.
intro.cn: hat 来自古英语 hæt，指头部覆盖物。

items.en: The root named a head covering.
items.cn: 该词根指头部覆盖物。

items.en: Hæt meant a hat or hood.
items.cn: hæt 指帽子或头巾。

items.en: Hat named the modern shaped hat.
items.cn: hat 指现代成形的帽子。

items.en: Hats marked rank and uniform.
items.cn: 帽子标示级别与制服。

items.en: Wearing hats came to mean roles.
items.cn: 戴帽子引申为承担角色。

note.en: Hat is compared with look-alike words and with words for headwear and roles.

He wears the hat of a teacher.

abstract.en: Change the hat and you change the voice.

abstract.en: Some hats are worn and some hats are earned.

examples.en: She wore a straw hat.

definition_en: to dislike someone or something very strongly
core_image: 攥紧的拳头和咬紧的牙关
scene: 她讨厌撒谎的人。She hates liars.
sceneCN: 这里 hate 是「讨厌、憎恨」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她讨厌撒谎的人。

senses.title: Dislike a thing
senses.definition: to dislike an activity or thing very much
senses.definitionCN: 非常不喜欢某项活动或某样东西
senses.example: I hate cold mornings.
senses.why: This is the everyday sense of strong dislike.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常表达强烈厌恶的义项。

senses.title: Feel hostility
senses.definition: to feel strong dislike toward a person
senses.definitionCN: 对某人怀有强烈的厌恶
senses.example: She hates liars.
senses.why: The feeling turns from a thing to a person.
senses.whyCN: 这种情绪从对事物转向对人。

senses.title: The feeling itself
senses.definition: a strong feeling of dislike kept inside
senses.definitionCN: 积在心中的强烈厌恶情绪
senses.example: His face was full of hate.

senses.whyCN: 动词转化为表示这种情感的名词。

intro.en: Hate goes back to an Old English verb for strong dislike.
intro.cn: hate 可追溯到古英语中表示强烈厌恶的动词。

items.en: The root expressed strong dislike.
items.cn: 该词根表达强烈的厌恶。

items.en: Old English hatian meant to hate.
items.cn: 古英语 hatian 意为憎恨。

items.en: Hate named the feeling as well as the act.
items.cn: hate 既指行为也指情感。

items.en: Hate became a strong word for dislike.
items.cn: hate 成为表达厌恶的强词。

items.en: Hate speech named words that stir hostility.
items.cn: 仇恨言论一词用来指煽动敌意的言辞。

note.en: Hate is compared with look-alike words and with words for strong dislike.
note.cn: 把 hate 与形近词以及表示强烈厌恶的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Hate is a hot feeling that turns against people or things.
normalIntro.cn: hate 是一种烧向人或物的强烈情绪。

normal.en: They hate waste of any kind.
normal.cn: 他们痛恨任何形式的浪费。

normal.en: His eyes were full of hate.

abstract.en: Hate is a fire that burns the one who holds it.
abstract.cn: 仇恨是烧向持火者自己的火。

abstract.en: Hate names the wound and keeps it open.
abstract.cn: 仇恨给伤口命名，还让它一直敞着。

abstract.en: The opposite of hate is not indifference but understanding.
abstract.cn: 恨的反面不是冷漠，而是理解。

examples.en: She hates liars.
I hate cold mornings.
His face was full of hate.

dict_mnemonic.text: hate 是「憎恨、讨厌」；hate to do 与 hate doing 都表示不愿做，hate speech 是仇恨言论，名词 hate 指仇恨这种情感。

root: 来自古英语 hatian（憎恨），与日耳曼语同源；由对人或物的强烈厌恶，发展为既可作动词也可作名词的仇恨。

sensesIntro.en: Hate is strong dislike for a thing, a person, or a group.
sensesIntro.cn: hate 是对事物、人或群体的强烈厌恶。

core.en: A hot feeling turned against someone.
core.cn: 一股转向某人的灼热情绪。

branches.en: I hate cold mornings.
branches.cn: 我讨厌寒冷的早晨。

branches.en: She hates liars.
branches.cn: 她讨厌撒谎的人。

branches.en: His face was full of hate.
branches.cn: 他脸上满是仇恨。

branches.en: The same feeling targets things and people.
branches.cn: 同一种情绪可以指向事物，也可以指向人。

branches.en: Hating a person hardens into hate.
branches.cn: 对人的憎恨，会硬化成仇恨。

intro.en: Hate takes endings and builds words about hating.
intro.cn: hate 加词尾，构成与憎恨相关的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: That was a hateful thing to say.
The law treats it as a hate crime.
items.exampleCN: 法律将其视为仇恨犯罪。

definition_en: a very strong and lasting feeling of hate
core_image: 一道多年没有合上的旧伤口
scene: 多年的仇恨让他无法原谅。Years of hatred kept him from forgiving.
sceneCN: 这里 hatred 是「仇恨」（第 1 个义项）；句意：多年的仇恨让他无法原谅。

senses.title: Deep personal hate
senses.definition: a very strong dislike that lasts a long time
senses.definitionCN: 持续很久的强烈厌恶
senses.example: Years of hatred kept him from forgiving.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的仇恨让他无法原谅。
senses.why: This is the core sense of lasting hate.
senses.whyCN: 这是持久恨意的核心义项。

senses.title: Hate between groups
senses.definition: hostile feeling between different groups of people
senses.definitionCN: 不同人群之间的敌意
senses.example: The speech spread hatred between the two groups.
senses.exampleCN: 那番话在两个群体之间散布仇恨。
senses.why: The feeling spreads from persons to groups.
senses.whyCN: 这种情绪从个人扩散到群体。

senses.title: Intense dislike of a thing
senses.definition: an intense dislike of something such as waste or lies
senses.definitionCN: 对浪费、谎言等事物的极度反感
senses.example: She has a hatred of waste.
senses.why: Hatred can fasten on habits and things.
senses.whyCN: 憎恨也能牢牢附着在习惯与事物上。

intro.en: Hatred joins the verb hate with an old suffix for a state.
intro.cn: hatred 由动词 hate 与表示状态的古后缀组合而成。

items.en: Hate came from hatian, to hate.
items.cn: hate 来自 hatian，意为憎恨。

items.en: The suffix ræden meant a condition.
items.cn: 后缀 ræden 表示状态。

items.en: Hate and the suffix shrank into hatred.
items.cn: hate 与后缀缩合成 hatred。

items.en: Hatred grew stronger than the simple verb.
items.cn: hatred 的语气比单纯动词更重。

items.en: Hatred also named hostility between groups.
items.cn: hatred 也指群体间的敌意。

note.en: Hatred is compared with look-alike words and with words for hostility.
note.cn: 把 hatred 与形近词以及表示敌意的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Hatred is hate that has settled in and stayed.
normalIntro.cn: hatred 是沉淀下来、久久不散的恨。

normal.en: Hatred grew between the two families.
normal.cn: 两个家族之间积起了仇恨。

normal.en: She spoke of him with hatred.

normal.cn: 那个团体在网上散布仇恨。
时间淡化了他们的仇恨。

abstract.en: Hatred is a debt that no one can pay.
abstract.cn: 仇恨是一笔无人能还的债。

abstract.en: Hatred keeps the past alive at the cost of the present.
abstract.cn: 仇恨让过去活着，却牺牲了现在。

abstract.en: Where hatred ends, room appears.
abstract.cn: 仇恨止处，空间自现。

examples.cn: 多年的仇恨让他无法原谅。

examples.en: The speech spread hatred between the two groups.
examples.cn: 那番话在两个群体之间散布仇恨。

examples.en: She has a hatred of waste.

dict_mnemonic.text: hatred 由 hate 加后缀构成，指持续的恨意；deep hatred 是深仇，racial hatred 是种族仇恨，语气比动词 hate 更重。

root: 由动词 hate 加古英语后缀 ræden（状态、境况）缩合而成，字面就是「憎恨的状态」；语气比 hate 更沉重，多指持久的恨意。

sensesIntro.en: Hatred is a deep and lasting feeling of hate.
sensesIntro.cn: hatred 是深沉而持久的恨意。

core.en: Hate that has hardened over time.
core.cn: 随时间硬化下来的恨。

branches.en: Years of hatred kept him from forgiving.
branches.cn: 多年的仇恨让他无法原谅。

branches.en: The speech spread hatred between groups.
branches.cn: 那番话在群体之间散布仇恨。

branches.en: She has a hatred of waste.
branches.cn: 她痛恨浪费。

branches.en: Personal hatred can feed group conflict.
branches.cn: 个人的仇恨会助长群体冲突。

branches.en: Hatred of a group and of a habit share one heat.
branches.cn: 对群体的恨与对习惯的恨，燃烧着同一种热度。

intro.en: Hatred builds on hate and takes a plural for kinds of hate.
intro.cn: hatred 以 hate 为基础，并可用复数表示种种仇恨。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: A hater of waste, she saved everything.
items.exampleCN: 她痛恨浪费，什么都留着。
可恨的话语会伤人多年。

items.example: He spoke hatefully of his rival.

definition_en: to own something, to take part in an activity, to cause something, or to form the perfect tense
core_image: 双手紧紧握住一件属于自己的东西
scene: 我有两只猫。I have two cats.
sceneCN: 这里 have 是「拥有」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我有两只猫。

senses.title: Own or hold
senses.definition: to own or hold something
senses.definitionCN: 拥有或持有某物
senses.example: I have two cats.
senses.why: This is the basic sense of possession.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示拥有的基本义项。

senses.title: Take part in
senses.definition: to eat, drink, or take part in an activity
senses.definitionCN: 吃、喝或参加某项活动
senses.example: We have breakfast at seven.
senses.why: Possession stretches to doing things.
senses.whyCN: 「拥有」延伸为「做某事」。

senses.title: Form the perfect tense
senses.definition: used with a past participle to build the perfect tense
senses.definitionCN: 与过去分词连用，构成完成时
senses.example: She has finished her work.
senses.why: The verb thins into a grammar helper.
senses.whyCN: 这个词虚化为语法助词。

senses.title: Make something happen
senses.definition: to cause something to be done or to make someone act
senses.definitionCN: 使某事被做成，或让人去做
senses.example: I had my hair cut.
senses.why: Holding becomes arranging and ordering.
senses.whyCN: 「握在手里」变成了安排与支使。

intro.en: Have is an old Germanic verb for holding.
intro.cn: have 是一个古老的日耳曼语动词，意为持有。

items.en: The root meant to hold or possess.
items.cn: 该词根意为持有或拥有。

items.en: Habban meant to have or hold.

items.en: Have took its modern spelling.
items.cn: have 定型为现代拼写。

items.en: Have became an auxiliary for perfect tenses.
items.cn: have 成为构成完成时的助动词。

items.en: Have also meant to eat or to cause.

note.en: Have is compared with look-alike words and with words for owning.
note.cn: 把 have 与形近词以及表示拥有的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Have holds things, takes actions, and builds perfect tenses.

abstract.en: To have is to hold, and to hold is to be responsible.
abstract.cn: 拥有就是握持，握持就是负责。

abstract.en: Have turns time into a single arc.
abstract.cn: have 把时间连成一道弧。

core.en: A hand closed around something.

branches.en: I had my hair cut.
branches.cn: 我让人理了发。

branches.cn: 握住一样东西，也让一件事发生。

latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.meaningCN: 晒制干草（第三人称单数）
items.example: He hays the field in June.
items.exampleCN: 他在六月晒制田里的草。

items.example: They hayed the meadow last week.
items.exampleCN: 他们上周晒制了草地的草。

items.example: The haystack stood by the barn.
Hay fever hits him in spring.

definition_zh: 危险；隐患；公害；冒险猜测
definition_en: something that could cause harm, or to risk a guess
core_image: 路面上被薄冰盖住的一道裂缝
scene: 湿滑的地面是个隐患。The wet floor is a hazard.
sceneCN: 这里 hazard 是「隐患」（第 1 个义项）；句意：湿滑的地面是个隐患。

senses.title: A source of danger
senses.definition: something that could cause harm or an accident
senses.definitionCN: 可能造成伤害或事故的事物
senses.example: The wet floor is a hazard.
senses.why: This is the everyday sense of a hidden risk.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常表示潜在危险的义项。

senses.title: Risk a guess
senses.definition: to say or try something without being sure
senses.definitionCN: 没有把握地说出或尝试某事
senses.example: He hazarded a guess.
senses.why: The noun turns into the act of taking a chance.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为冒险一试的行为。

senses.title: A public danger
senses.definition: a danger to health or safety in a place
senses.definitionCN: 某处对健康或安全的危害
senses.example: Smoke is a health hazard.
senses.why: The risk becomes a named public problem.
senses.whyCN: 风险变成了被点名的公共问题。

intro.en: Hazard entered English through Old French as a dice game.
intro.cn: hazard 经古法语进入英语，最初指一种掷骰游戏。

items.en: The word may come from an Arabic word for dice.
items.cn: 这个词可能来自阿拉伯语中表示骰子的词。

items.en: Hasard named a game of dice.
items.cn: hasard 指一种掷骰游戏。

items.en: Hazard meant chance or luck in a game.
items.cn: hazard 指游戏中的偶然与运气。

items.en: Hazard shifted to mean danger or risk.
items.cn: hazard 转指危险或风险。

items.en: Hazard also named a source of harm.
items.cn: hazard 也指危害的来源。

note.en: Hazard is compared with look-alike words and with words for danger.
note.cn: 把 hazard 与形近词以及表示危险的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Hazard is harm waiting to happen.
normalIntro.cn: hazard 是随时可能发生的伤害。

normal.cn: 他们清除了所有火灾隐患。

abstract.en: A hazard is a shadow cast by a possible accident.
abstract.cn: 隐患，是可能事故投下的影子。

abstract.en: Name the hazard and it shrinks.
abstract.cn: 把隐患说出来，它就变小了。

abstract.en: Luck and hazard share one die.
abstract.cn: 运气与危险共用同一颗骰子。

examples.en: The wet floor is a hazard.
He hazarded a guess.
Smoke is a health hazard.

dict_mnemonic.text: hazard 是「危险、隐患」；health hazard 是健康危害，fire hazard 是火灾隐患，hazard a guess 是壮着胆子猜一猜。

root: 经古法语 hasard（掷骰游戏）进入英语，词源或可追溯至阿拉伯语中表示骰子的词；由赌局中的偶然与运气，转指危险与风险。

sensesIntro.en: Hazard is a source of harm, a health danger, or the act of risking a guess.
sensesIntro.cn: hazard 是危害源、健康隐患，或冒险猜测的行为。

core.en: A hidden edge where harm may start.
core.cn: 伤害可能开始的一道暗边。

branches.en: The wet floor is a hazard.
branches.cn: 湿滑的地面是个隐患。

branches.en: He hazarded a guess.
branches.cn: 他大胆猜了一下。

branches.en: Smoke is a health hazard.
branches.cn: 烟雾是健康危害。

branches.en: A small risk becomes a public danger.
branches.cn: 小小的风险会变成公共的危害。

branches.en: To guess at hazard is to roll the dice.
branches.cn: 冒险一猜，就是在掷骰子。

intro.en: Hazard takes suffixes for danger and compounds for warnings.
intro.cn: hazard 加后缀表示危险，并构成警示类复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word came through Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，是经古法语传入的。

items.meaning: a dice game, later a risk

items.exampleCN: 危险废物需要谨慎处理。
